messages:
hana (Finance): Heads-up 1: we rolled into close and our unbilled usage accrual looks understated by ~ $12.4k after a late vendor invoice from EdgeCloud arrived. Uploaded invoice + support: s3://redwood-bills/vendors/edgecloud/INV-EC-043.pdf :file_folder:
mike (Billing Ops): Can you paste the relevant invoice lines? Is it usage we failed to capture or a post-bill adjustment?
hana (Finance): From the PDF: ```
EdgeCloud egress pass-through Mar 20-31 | 24,800 GB | $0.50/GB | $12,400.00
```
tara (FP&A): Confirming: our March unbilled accrual was $18k; with this invoice it should be $30.4k. That moves recognized COGS upward in March. Materiality: below our $50k restatement threshold but after close. Recommend prior-period accrual journal rather than restatement.
jorge (Controller): Agreed. For <$50k we do prior-period adjusting JE. Provide GL mapping and memo, and attach vendor invoice + tickets.
mike (Billing Ops): How did this miss happen? Looks like EdgeCloud started a new egress meter (meter_id: ec-egress-v2) that our billing ingestion pipeline didn't map to passthrough. I'll open a ticket and add a quick mapping in billing-config.
billing-bot (billing-bot): Created ticket BILL-9244 1 mapping missing for meter ec-egress-v2. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9244
hana (Finance): Proposed JE to post in March period: debit 6100 COGS - Pass-through $12,400.00; credit 2602 Accrued Unbilled Liabilities $12,400.00. JE memo: "EdgeCloud late vendor invoice - adjust unbilled accrual (INV-EC-043)". Target posting: EOD tomorrow.
tara (FP&A): I support the accrual. Please also add a one-line note in month-close pack explaining the vendor meter change and potential impact for April. I'll adjust cash flow forecast for vendor pay timing.
jorge (Controller): Approved. Post JE with attachments and include ticket BILL-9244. If we see more than $100k of similar omissions across vendors next month escalate to audit team.
mike (Billing Ops): Will patch billing ingestion to map ec-egress-v2 and backfill ingestion for Mar. Adding a deploy note: "BILL-9244 mapping + backfill".
hana (Finance): Thanks 1 I'll queue the JE in NetSuite and ping for sign-off. Closing note: if more vendor meters appear, we'll add a weekly ingest audit for passthrough meters.
